adsense.notes: AdSense is a website advertising product. It is not enabled in the installed Windows app or the MSIX/WebView2 package; written confirmation for any broader use is required. See docs/windows/ADS-INTEGRATION.md.

monetag.notes: Not integrated. Monetag tag compatibility with the MSIX/WebView2 package has not been verified in writing.

adsterra.notes: Existing website banner loader stays on the public web pages only; not enabled in the Windows app shell.

mgads.notes: MG Ads is a UWP SDK (Miracle Games). A PWABuilder MSIX is a Win32/PWA host, not a UWP app, so this SDK cannot be attached to it. See the investigation in docs/windows/ADS-INTEGRATION.md.
